messages:
Asha Patel: Quick PSA — launching a 'fast-backport' lane for critical regressions this release train. Freeze window starts 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC. If you need a backport after freeze, use the fast lane and follow the checklist below. TL;DR: only emergency fixes, tests + canary required. @eng @oncall
Diego Ramos: Does this change the usual canary timing? We had app-level canary scheduled for Thu 14:00 UTC.
Asha Patel: Good q. Canary timing stays but we'll reserve a short hotbackport slot 30m before canary to merge approved fast-lane PRs. All merges require :white_check_mark: CI and :lock: approval from Release Lead.
Sana Khan: Who's Release Lead this week?
Lindsey Wu: I'm RL Thu-Fri. Ping me in thread for approvals during the window.
ci-bot: CI results for branch main: nightly build ✅, integration-test-suite failing in test/routing_spec.py:42 (flaky). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/ci/2991234567
Asha Patel: Thanks @ci-bot. If that flaky test bleeds into canary, we'll block fast-lane merges until it's green or quarantined. Please don't merge fast-lane PRs with unrelated test failures.
Deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: Thu 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC -> 15:00 UTC. Canary hosts: eu-west-1 (50%) -> us-west-2 (100% gradual). Canary hooks: /ops/canary-checklist
Diego Ramos: For backports, what's the required commit message prefix?
Asha Patel: Use 'hotfix(fast-backport): <brief description>' and include the original PR number. Also add 'backport-rl: @Lindsey' label.
Sana Khan: Adding checklist snippet for fast-lane merges:
```bash
git checkout -b backport/PR-123-hotfix
./scripts/backport.sh PR-123
# run unit + smoke
ci/trigger --smoke
```
Oncall: Oncall here — if any infra impact post-merge, tag #eng-oncall and escalate per usual SLO-runbook.
Asha Patel: Extra note — Dedicated customers: if your change touches routing or weight logic, coordinate with Platform lead (cc @Diego) before requesting fast-lane approval.
Lindsey Wu: Acknowledged. I'll be monitoring approvals and canary telemetry during the window. Use this thread for approvals; I will react with :thumbsup: when I approve.
Diego Ramos: Noted — will hold non-critical backports. Thanks.
Sana Khan: 👍
Asha Patel: Thanks team. Filing the policy doc here: https://docs.redwood.internal/release/fast-backport-policy and adding the checklist to the release train page.
